collection.title: KIA Cee'd Hatchback 2006 to 2009 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a KIA Cee'd Hatchback 2006 to 2009 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Cee'd Hatchback, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
